objectives: To develop a centralized scholarship management system that enables students to apply and submit required documents, while allowing grantors and administrators to manage scholarship postings, evaluate applicants, and process approvals efficiently within a unified platform.

To develop a system that validates student records, helps prevent multiple active scholarships, and supports duplication prevention using internal scholarship records and externally sourced scholarship records encoded into the system.

To develop a system that provides scholarship recommendations, manages the scholarship lifecycle (application, approval, active status, renewal, and completion), and monitors student compliance and academic performance.
